stages.title: Ratio Required
stages.teaches: Lethal · Currents — the order you attack in is the puzzle

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Win this turn. Their bodyguard has to fall first, and you only get one swing at the leader afterwards — so it matters which character you spend on the wall.

stages.title: Encore, Encore
stages.teaches: Lethal · Confluence — two Currents buy a second swing

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Eight health, and you have four attack on the board. The two cards in your hand are not there to trade — they are there because of what they are.

stages.title: Bait the Clip
stages.teaches: Lethal · Reactions — a Reaction that kills your attacker cancels the attack

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Their bodyguard blocks the way, and a face-down Reaction deals 3 to whatever attacks their characters — killing your attacker before its blow ever lands. Something has to walk into that. Choose which.

stages.title: Terminally Devoted
stages.teaches: Lethal · Obsession — Parasocial pays twice, and it has to be paid first

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Eight health, one card, one Hype, and two Obsession — one short of your Fixation. Both of your characters can be given +2/+1. Only one of them will pay you back for it.

stages.title: Hold the Line
stages.teaches: Survival · statuses — Scorched resolves at the end of YOUR turn, before they ever swing

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Survive their turn. Your bodyguard has Spotlight, so nothing can walk past it — but it is Scorched and on 1 health, and Scorched burns at the end of YOUR turn, not theirs.

stages.title: Peaked Too Early
stages.teaches: Economy · Trending & Rushwind — the big card gets cheaper AND better if it goes last

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Seven health and five Hype. Follower Frenzy costs five on its own — but it is Trending, and it has Rushwind. Both of those care about what you did before you played it.

stages.title: Louder Each Time
stages.teaches: Combo · Repost — the third copy hits hardest, so they all go to the same place

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Their bodyguard has four health and you are holding two copies of the same two-damage joke. Repost makes each copy hit harder than the last — but only if the earlier ones were already told.

stages.title: Rush Hour
stages.teaches: Combo · Rushwind — warm the crowd up first and the same card hits for one more

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Three Hype, two cards, and a three-health bodyguard in the way. Ratio Bomb deals two — unless something went before it.

stages.title: Mutually Assured
stages.teaches: Currents · Halo and Veil — the only pair that beats each other, both ways

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Their bodyguard is Halo and has three health. One of your two characters beats Halo and one does not — and whichever you send in, the other one is your only shot at the leader.

stages.title: Blank Stare
stages.teaches: Survival · Cancel — you can only silence one of them, so silence the one that kills you

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Survive their turn. You are on four health and they have five attack across two bodies. You can blank exactly one of them.

stages.title: Shield Wall
stages.teaches: Survival · Shielded — it negates one instance of damage, so it goes where the big one lands

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Two four-attack bodies and you are on three health. Your bodyguard has Spotlight, so the first of them has to go through it — the question is whether it is still standing for the second.

stages.title: Second Wind
stages.teaches: Lethal · Fixation — one body, two swings, and a bodyguard in between

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: One character, one bodyguard, and three health behind it. Redline costs three Obsession and two of your own health — you have exactly three Obsession.

stages.title: Sanctuary
stages.teaches: Currents · Confluence — a free card is still a Current played

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: One Hype, two cards, and a Scorched bodyguard that burns to death at the end of your turn. Sanctuary would shield it and scrub the burn off — but Sanctuary wants a Root card and a Halo card played this turn, and you can only afford one of them. Unless one of them pays for itself.

stages.title: Starflare
stages.teaches: Currents · Confluence — Shielded stops damage, not Starflare

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Their bodyguard is Shielded, so the first hit it takes simply does not happen. Your two cheap characters are a Cinder and a Pulse — which is the pair that lights Starflare, and Starflare does not care about Shielded.

stages.title: Cold Water
stages.teaches: Currents · Pulse beats Tide — same attack, different answer

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Both of your characters hit for three. Their bodyguard is Tide with four health, so three is not enough — unless the one swinging has the Current that beats Tide.

stages.title: Weather Front
stages.teaches: Survival · Weakened — taking the teeth out beats patching the wound

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Six attack is pointed at your four health, and you have four Hype — enough for exactly one of the two cards in your hand. One of them adds health. The other takes attack away.

stages.title: Sandstorm
stages.teaches: Currents · Confluence — two Currents make a Confluence, but only the right two

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Six attack across three bodies, and you are on five. Three Hype buys two of your three cards — and which two decides which Confluence you get, not whether you get one.

stages.title: Obsessed
stages.teaches: Survival · Obsession — past eight, every hit you take is worth one more

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Two one-attack bodies against your three health. That is survivable — but you are on seven Obsession, and at eight every enemy source hits for one more.

stages.title: Bloom
stages.teaches: Currents · Confluence — Tide and Root are the only pair that mends a character

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Your bodyguard is down to one health and there are two of them out there — the first kills it, the second walks past it to you, and you are on one. Two of your three cards are a Tide and a Root, which is the pair that mends. The third is a Pulse that pairs with neither.

stages.title: Full Hand
stages.teaches: Economy · the hand limit — a card drawn with no room is burned, not held

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Your hand is full and the card that finishes this is two down in your deck. The draw spell frees its own slot as it leaves your hand — but it fetches two, and the second one has nowhere to land.

stages.title: Cold Start
stages.teaches: Lethal · Raid — a body played this turn cannot swing unless it says otherwise

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Two Hype and two bodies in hand: a three-attack one and a two-attack one. Their leader is on two, and only one of these can actually swing today.

stages.title: Collab
stages.teaches: Combo · Collab — the bonus checks the board, so the order you build it in matters

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Their bodyguard has four health and your only ready character hits for three. The Imp is a Demon that grows if another Demon is already standing beside it — and the Familiar brings one of its own.

stages.title: Storm Warning
stages.teaches: Currents · Confluence — Tempest's other half sweeps a wide board, one damage at a time

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Four one-health bodies, four damage, and you are on three. One clean kill is not enough — you need to thin the whole row, and Gale plus Pulse is the pair that does it.

stages.title: Blackflame
stages.teaches: Currents · Confluence — when nothing in your hand deals damage, the Confluence is your removal

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: A two-health bodyguard is in the way and neither card in your hand does a point of damage. One is Cinder and one is Veil — which is the pair that burns.

stages.title: Inspired
stages.teaches: Combo · Inspire — supporting anything friendly wakes it up, including itself

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Six health and one three-attack character. The card in your hand adds two — which is still one short, unless the character it lands on notices.

stages.title: Flow
stages.teaches: Combo · Flow — pulling a friend back out of the fight is what sets it off

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Your anchor hits for two and they are on three. Re-Upload pulls a friendly character back to your hand — pull the wrong one and you have thrown away your only attacker.

stages.title: Double Duty
stages.teaches: Lethal · Spotlight — two bodyguards, two answers, and only one of them is a card

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Two bodyguards, both of which have to fall before anything reaches the leader — and three health behind them. You have two characters and one spell, which is exactly one answer too few unless the spell does a bodyguard's worth of work.

stages.title: Nobody's Friend
stages.teaches: Currents · Prism — it beats nothing and nothing beats it, so bring the bigger number

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Their bodyguard is Prism, which no Current beats and which beats no Current back. Your Pulse character has been carrying the elemental bonus all game and it is worth nothing here.

stages.title: Full Fixation
stages.teaches: Lethal · Obsession — at ten, the Ultimate is free, which is the only way to afford both

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Two one-attack bodies and seven health to get through. Your Ultimate costs seven Obsession and your Fixation costs three — you have ten, and you need both.

stages.title: Cheap Imitation
stages.teaches: Combo · Viral — the copy costs one less, and a free card still counts as a card played

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Four Hype and a five-cost finisher. The little Pulse character makes a copy of itself that costs one less — and Follower Frenzy gets cheaper for every card that went before it.

stages.title: Last Call
stages.teaches: Lethal · Last Call — some damage arrives on your next turn, which still counts

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: One Hype, two cards, and a leader on two that your board cannot touch. One of these cards deals damage now, to something that is not the leader. The other deals it later, to something that is.

stages.title: Bodyguard Detail
stages.teaches: Survival · Equipment — Spotlight can be handed out, so hand it to something that can take a hit

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Eight attack pointed at three health. Nothing on your board has Spotlight — but the Bylaws grant it, along with +1/+2. Whoever you pin it on is going to be attacked twice.

stages.title: Eclipse
stages.teaches: Currents · Confluence — turn the aura off and the numbers go back to what the cards say

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Their leader is standing behind a Centre Position, which is quietly giving both of its Idols an extra point of attack. Seven health, and what is coming is worth exactly that — unless the aura stops counting.

stages.title: Chain Reaction
stages.teaches: Combo · Chain — the bonus reads the board, so the friend has to arrive first

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Their bodyguard has two health and your one ready character hits for exactly two — spend it there and there is nothing left for the leader. Bad Influence deals two as well, but only if another Afterparty character is already standing when it lands.

stages.title: Slow Burn
stages.teaches: Currents · Scorched — the burn lands at the end of the turn of whoever is carrying it

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Their bodyguard has two health and one Hype buys a point of damage plus a burn. The burn resolves at the end of THEIR turn, not yours — so it clears the way without costing you your attack.

stages.title: No Substitute
stages.teaches: Survival · Spotlight — bodies do not protect you, Spotlight does

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Four attack against three health, and three Hype. One card gives you two bodies. The other gives you one — and the only thing on the board that anything is obliged to attack.

stages.title: Deep Breath
stages.teaches: Economy · Burnout — an empty deck is a clock, and it is already running

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Their leader is on two and so is your board. Your deck is empty, you are on one health, and the card in your hand draws you another one.

stages.title: Thin Ice
stages.teaches: Survival · Armor — it soaks damage before your health does, so small hits stop mattering

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: One health and two Armor, against a four and a two. You can blank one of them — and Armor is spent before your health is, which changes which one is actually dangerous.

stages.title: Closing Time
stages.teaches: Lethal · a Confluence is removal you did not have to draw

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Your Pulse character could clear that Tide bodyguard on its own — and then there is nothing left to swing at the leader. The two cards in your hand deal no damage between them, but they are a Cinder and a Pulse.

stages.title: Last Word
stages.teaches: Lethal · the whole set — a Confluence to clear it, Raid to reach them, and exactly enough Hype

say.speaker: Puzzle
say.text: Four Hype, four cards, an empty board of your own, a bodyguard in the way and four health behind it. Everything in your hand is needed and there is exactly one order that spends it all.
